description: The latest dev build of pig, a thin GUI client for the pi agent harness
notes: Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. This build is unsigned. Nightly downloads skip hash verification and are re-downloaded by Scoop updates.
pig and pig-nightly are separate Scoop apps sharing the pig shim and shortcut; installing both causes conflicts. Switch with 'scoop reset pig' or 'scoop reset pig-nightly'.

Exit all pig instances before updating or switching. To switch from Electrobun to Tauri, run 'scoop update pig-nightly --force --no-cache'. Tauri desktop settings are separate; uninstall does not delete your data.
